comparison.objective: Align and cam-lock glass plates, transfer the cassette into a casting stand, and release its spring clip; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests plate alignment, two pressure-cam operations, constrained assembly insertion, clip release, transfer, and stable withdrawal; candidate tests hex-key engagement, counterholding, collar rotation, torque-limited locking, and iterative dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires a secured cassette stably seated in its stand after clip release and gripper withdrawal; candidate requires two safe dynamic stops and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual stabilization and locking hardware, but cassette assembly/transfer does not test adjustable damping or response-based commissioning. No spec versions or numeric alignment/stability thresholds are included.
